Spec: `docs/tickets/156c_R4.7c__observability-live-sink.md` (seq 156c).
Depends on R4.7b (stacked; base `svitali/harnessharness-r4.7b` @
`16c2598`) + HUMAN-H6's provisioned local collector
(`jaegertracing/jaeger:2.22.0` — USD 0 loopback, operator-started per
leg). Requirement ids: **BL-31** (ADR-0346 live-sink member discharged —
the row stays open only as a flip-pass candidate; its named members are
all landed) · **ADR-0346** revisit trigger (a) (fired-answered —
`docs/build/reports/2026-10-22-adr-0346-trigger.md`; triggers (b)/(c)

evidence class).

## Summary

- **`crates/hh-telemetry/src/otlp.rs`** (new, 431 lines) — the
  OTLP/HTTP (JSON) wire lowering: `trace_service_request` folds the
  `gen_ai`-lowered convention spans into an
  `ExportTraceServiceRequest` — `resourceSpans{resource.attributes
  [service.name], scopeSpans{name:hh.telemetry}}`; per span `traceId =
  propagation::trace_id(hh.run_id)`, `spanId = span_id(hh.event_id)`,
  `startTimeUnixNano` anchored at the event's durable `ts`
  (`clocks::ts_ms`), `endTimeUnixNano = start + duration_ms`;
  convention attributes lower to OTLP `KeyValue{key,value:AnyValue}`
  (`stringValue`/`intValue`/`doubleValue`/`boolValue`/`arrayValue`);
  `hh.run_id`/`hh.event_id`/`seq`/`kind`/`class` lift coordinates ride
  as attributes (read-back names the ledger row). A span without
  `hh.*` coordinates or an unparseable anchor `ts` is a named
  `loss_entry` — never a fabricated identity; `error:true` marks the
  OTLP status surface honestly.
- **`crates/hh-embed/src/subscriber.rs`** — `SinkDestination` gains
  `wire: SinkWire` (`BatchJson` default — the landed fixture dialect
  untouched; `OtlpTraces { service_name }` — the R4.7c live-sink
  dialect). `poll`'s fold becomes `wire_fold`: `BatchJson` reuses
  `export_events` verbatim; `OtlpTraces` applies the *same* policy
  gates — `sampled_keep` (now `pub`, CC1), `cap_strings` on attribute
  leaves, and a `content_class_withheld` named loss strips
  `gen_ai.evaluation.explanation` when `content` is not a declared
  class — then POSTs through the same single `net_egress`
  `EgressRequest`. **`measurement.export.delivered` is now
  ack-gated**: `MediatedOutcome::Forwarded` with a non-2xx wire status
  answers the new `PollOutcome::NotAcknowledged` (decided{allow} +
  `network.calls` charge durable; *no* delivery row); `Refused`/
  `RefusedCredential`/`Asked` stay `Refused` with the
  `security.egress.*` rows. A delta entirely outside the span
  projection answers `Quiet` — consumed, never sent, never claimed.
- **`crates/hh-telemetry/src/export.rs`** — `sampled_keep` +
  `cap_strings` → `pub` (the wire fold applies the same spellings —
  CC1, no second rule).
- **`scripts/live-verify.sh`** — the `otel-live` leg
  (`run_leg_otel_live`): starts the operator-provisioned collector
  (`docker run -p 127.0.0.1:4318:4318 -p 127.0.0.1:16686:16686
  jaegertracing/jaeger:2.22.0`), waits on
  `GET :16686/api/v3/services`, runs the gated export cell, parses the
  `LIVE_TRACE_ID:` marker, and asserts the collector answers
  `GET :16686/api/v3/traces/<tid>` with the same trace — read-back is
  the delivery proof. Container removed on every arm. Absent
  docker/image/readiness/marker records `skipped(<reason>)`, never a
  pass. USD 0 (`--budget 0`; R4.7c carries no pricing allocation).

## Verification (verbatim tails)

  `resourceSpans.scopeSpans.spans[0]` carries `traceId`/`spanId` from
  the landed derivations, `hh.event_id` + `gen_ai.*` attributes;
  `measurement.export.delivered` durable) ·
  `otlp_rejected_delivery_is_not_acknowledged_never_a_delivered_row`
  (fixture 400 → `NotAcknowledged{status:400}`; zero delivered rows;
  decided{allow} durable) ·
  `unlisted_otlp_sink_is_egress_refusal_never_a_delivered_row` (deny →
  `Refused`; decided{deny} durable; zero delivered rows) ·
  `model_free_delta_is_quiet_and_consumed` (nothing projects →

- `cargo test -p hh-embed --test r2_14` — **2 passed** (the BatchJson
  dialect unchanged); `cargo test -p hh-telemetry` — **52 passed**
  incl. 3 `otlp` units (AnyValue lowering, W3C id derivation + nano
  anchoring, missing-coords named loss).
- `cargo test -p hh-kernel --test surface_inventory` — 1 passed.
- `cargo clippy -p hh-telemetry -p hh-embed --all-targets -- -D
  warnings` — clean; `cargo fmt --all --check` — clean;
  `bash scripts/check-drift.sh` — in sync;
  `bash scripts/ci/check-ci-gating.sh .github/workflows/ci.yml` — OK;
  `check-build-memory.sh .` — 0 violations.
- **Live leg — live-executed:** `scripts/live-verify.sh otel-live
  --budget 0 --harness hh-embed` → `live-verify: leg otel-live →
  pass`; `hh-live-evidence/1` record
  `docs/build/reports/live/2026-10-22-otel-live.json` + redacted
  transcript (cost_usd 0, cumulative unchanged; gitleaks staged gate
  clean). Transcript tail:
  `LIVE_TRACE_ID: 89cde720dfc6ac8099cb44a1ee2adf5e` ·
  `LIVE_DELIVERED_SEQ: 10` · `GET :16686/api/v3/traces/…` answers
  `{"result":{"resourceSpans":[{"resource":{"attributes":[{"key":
  "service.name","value":{"stringValue":"hh.exporter.live"}}]},
  "scopeSpans":[…{"traceId":"89cde720dfc6ac8099cb44a1ee2adf5e",
  "name":"gen_ai.chat"…` — the collector indexed the run's spans;
  `/api/v3/services` lists `hh.exporter.live`.
- Owned decision: the leg exports a *minted* durable run
  (`EventMinter` rows) rather than a `GatewayModel` call — the
  ticket's "short local run" is the durable ledger run; a model call
  adds spend surface and a second provision dependency for no
  additional delivery proof.

## Deviation (recorded — GATE-G7 channel)

**1,867 changed lines excl. generated/fixtures vs the 600 budget**
(≈3.1×). The surface is irreducibly: a second wire dialect (otlp.rs
431 + subscriber wiring ~250), the required ack/reject/refuse/quiet
fixture battery (532), the gated live cell + docker-managing leg
(~320), and the mandated records (~300 — run ledger, trigger note,
BL-31 append, live evidence). Slimming below 600 drops a required
acceptance leg. Surfaced for the operator's merge gate per the
live-track overrun precedent (R4.7b).
